answers.question: How many of the same product can I put in my basket?

pieces.text: A customer can add at most 10 units of the same item. A cart can hold at most 50 different items.

If any item is already added into the cart and user is adding it again then it should update the quantity. It should not show same item two times. The limit of 10 units per item still applies when an item is added again. If the new total would be more than 10, the quantity is set to 10 and the customer sees a message that explains the limit.
A customer can apply one discount code per order. A second code replaces the first one. Codes are not case sensitive.

answers.answer: You can add up to 10 units of the same product to your basket.
